answer: Echo-correlation slashing: each answer is scored by 5 randomly drawn graders, and any two keys whose grades echo each other above 90% over 20 epochs both lose their bonds. A 10-key sybil ring in a 1,500-key pool lands a member on its own answer's panel only ~3% of the time, so collusion barely moves scores while risking 10 x 1,000 = 10,000 POA per flagged cluster. Ivory-tower influence at a quill's price is not on offer.
